E01.name: Workbook Intake
mustNot: put project data in the URL

E02.name: Automatic Schema Mapping + Confirmation
E02.input: E01 immutable raw workbook snapshot + HUF-SS-INPUT-v1.1 schema
mustNot: put project data in the URL

E03.name: Canonicalization & Analysis-Ready Data Model
E03.input: E01 immutable raw snapshot + finalized E02 mapping snapshot + HUF canonicalization policy
canonicalizationRules: standard workbook units are canonical by schema
explicit supported source units are converted deterministically
unsupported explicit units remain diagnostic/null rather than guessed
mustNot: put project data in the URL

E04.name: Validation & Readiness
E04.input: E03 immutable canonical snapshot + Design 4 validation rulebook + Design 1 route registry context
scopeIsolation: rainfall series blocker -> linked WTR-111 simulation windows only
cascade network blocker -> affected component only
person-day blocker -> affected claim/work scope only
mustNot: put project data in the URL

E05.name: Eligibility & Official Routing
E05.input: E03 immutable canonical snapshot + E04 immutable validation snapshot + frozen Design 1 route registry + E05 routing policy
E05.waterRouteInvariant: at most one official frozen water route per valid structure/intervention/reporting run; unresolved route-defining inputs remain null/unresolved rather than guessed
E05.personDayInvariant: one category-based PD route per valid claim; independent from water readiness
mustNot: reroute a record merely because calculation inputs are not-ready
put project data in the URL

E06.name: Versioned Calculation Core
E06.input: E03 immutable canonical snapshot + E04 validation snapshot + E05 official routing snapshot + frozen Design 2 v1.1 formula catalog
E06.calculationInvariant: Only eligible / eligible_with_warning official E05 routes calculate. HOLD, excluded, unresolved and not-ready remain null, never zero.
E06.formulaInvariant: E06 is the sole official KPI calculation layer and retains full IEEE-754 precision internally.
mustNot: put project data in the URL

E07.name: Assurance
E07.input: E03 canonical + E04 validation + E05 routing + immutable E06 calculation snapshot + Design 5 assurance policy/evidence
E07.invariant: Assurance references immutable E06 results and never changes calculation values. Calculation/method warnings are distinct from evidence-only gaps.
mustNot: put project data in the URL

E08.name: Status-Segregated Aggregation
E08.input: E03 canonical + immutable E06 calculation + immutable E07 assurance snapshot + Design 5 aggregation schema/policy
E08.invariant: Each source E07 result contributes to exactly one assurance bucket at each applicable reporting level. Terminal statuses carry counts but null numeric totals.
mustNot: label Calculated Total as Certified Total
put project data in the URL

E09.name: Audit & Run Manifest
E09.input: E01 intake summary + immutable E02–E08 snapshots + Design 5 result/audit schema + E09 audit policy
E09.invariant: E09 records provenance only. It never changes upstream truth. Standard audit export excludes raw workbook bytes, full canonical tables and raw participant names.
mustNot: put project data in the URL
include hidden reasoning in audit events
